description: Source code for an API Document Loader class that fetches data from APIs (GET/POST), handles SSL certificates, and processes documents with optional text splitting and metadata management.

classes.name: API_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Implements a node for loading documents from an API, supporting GET and POST methods, SSL certificates, and optional text splitting.

classes.name: ApiLoader
classes.description: Handles the actual HTTP requests (GET/POST) to fetch data and convert responses into document objects.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the loader with parameters, performs API requests, processes documents, and returns either documents or concatenated text.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Performs the API request based on the method (GET/POST) and returns documents.

methods.name: executeGetRequest
methods.description: Executes an HTTP GET request, returns response as a document.

methods.name: executePostRequest
methods.description: Executes an HTTP POST request, returns response as a document.
